A man claiming to be a time traveller has shared videos purportedly from 2050, showing the aftermath of World War Three including a rusted Eiffel Tower and Russian planes with bullet holes

07:00, 15 Sep 2026Updated 08:22, 15 Sep 2026

A self-proclaimed time-traveller has claimed to reveal the devastating consequences following World War Three. Through a collection of clips posted on social media via the account @unknown. path31, the man shows what he alleges is a corroded Eiffel Tower alongside Russian aircraft riddled with bullet damage.

‌

In this footage, the person claiming to be a time-traveller states he's in Paris during 2050, ominously declaring that "something happened." He presents a deteriorated Eiffel Tower surrounded by crumbling concrete slabs with not a single tourist visible, at one moment retrieving a crushed and empty Red Bull tin.

‌

The footage commentator mentions there are "vines growing on the metal" and "complete silence" with Notre Dame Cathedral appearing "old and grey" while "grass growing through the roads."

‌

‌

He swiftly moves the camera towards the Cathedral, displaying a weathered, more ashen iteration of the Parisian monument.

The TikTok profile boasts 26,000 followers and has uploaded numerous peculiar clips, including one purporting to feature Abraham Lincoln and Michael Jackson - both containing AI-generated material.

The video commentator subsequently claims to be positioned in Russia during 2050 at a deserted military airfield.

Article continues below

The narrator states that in Russia there exists a "military airport destroyed", alongside an "old Russian plane full of bullet holes" with "wings ripped apart."

He appears to display a partially vacant airstrip featuring corroded aircraft he maintains are Russian. Then the man appears to discover an old colossal ship, but it's stranded on land with no water in sight, encircled by desert.

The narrator states: "Everything abandoned, the world is empty, just wind."
